notes: Thirty-five source and forty-two target tokens each partitioned once.
אֶל → because of is one multi-word English preposition of which no morpheme owns a part, headed on because under rule 24.
אֲשֶׁר is rendered by the causal for; nothing else in the clause licenses that word.
The three assimilated [הַ] tokens each take a written the under rule 12; the ASV fronts the clause's verb before all three prepositional phrases, so s035's unit precedes them in the target.
